segments.name: Coffee Bars
segments.description: Operates company-owned drive-thru coffee bars selling handcrafted beverages and food to guests in the communities it serves.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and one reportable segment, as the CODM allocates resources and regularly reviews operations and financial performance at a consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay the company for handcrafted beverages and food purchased at its drive-thru coffee bars and in-store lobbies.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer a curated selection of handcrafted beverages and food items that balance approachability with innovation, ensuring that every guest can find something they love.
